Agronomist</font>"> <mxGeometry entryPerimeter="1" entryX="0.2" entryY="0" exitPerimeter="1" exitX="1" exitY="0.5" relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="2972" y="447" /> </Array> style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#10b981;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacing=8;" value="<b>MISSION INVARIANTS (Section 5.3 / A15 / A17):</b><br/>• <b>Five Mandatory Services:</b> <i>'Los cinco entran. No se sustituye uno por otro.'</i> Types: <code>delimitation</code>, <code>confirmation</code>, <code>fumigation</code>, <code>verification</code>, <code>estimation</code>.<br/>• <b>Upload Quarantine:</b> Objects failing grant/checksum checks go to <code>quarantine/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/</code> and do <b>NOT</b> count toward persistence (PD-104).<br/>• <b>Inference Decoupling:</b> Drone inference functions trigger on <code>mission_record_persisted</code> via DynamoDB Streams -> EventBridge, <b>NEVER</b> on raw S3 object arrival (ASM-149).<br/>• <b>Flight Without Persisted Record:</b> A mission in <code>dispatched</code> or <code>flown</code> without a persisted record is flagged as unpersisted flight (Point 6 / A21)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="1020" x="2320" y="1650" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_bottom_roles" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="3320" x="40" y="2100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_bottom_hdr" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;spacingLeft=15;" value="CROSS-CUTTING GOVERNANCE, ACTOR ROLES & LIFECYCLE INVARIANTS (docs/drone-service.md, ADR-002, A09, A15, A17)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="3300" x="50" y="2110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pnl_col_60" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#334155;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacing=6;" value="<b>1. Agronomist Role (SR2/JR2 | Cognito staff MFA):</b><br/>• Only authorized identity for fumigation orders.<br/>• Must have fresh MFA session (auth_time <= 10 min, ASM-092).<br/>• Authorizer ID captured from token; cannot be operator.<br/>• Re-checks cases: closes without fumigation or requests new confirmation / verification.<br/>• Sets window (window_start, window_end) and product batch." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="800" x="60" y="2155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pnl_col_880" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#334155;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacing=6;" value="<b>2. Contracted Pilot & Drone Kit (A09 sec 6):</b><br/>• Pilot in Cognito staff with MFA; Aerocivil permit verified (ASM-020).<br/>• Drone Kit registered as AWS IoT Thing with X.509 certificate.<br/>• Upload Grant: IoT MQTT grant limits uploads to exact S3 keys.<br/>• Preload: Mission package downloaded before takeoff.<br/>• Non-volatile encrypted buffer: Survives zero-signal flights.<br/>• Buffer eviction: Strictly conditional on persistence receipt." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="800" x="880" y="2155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pnl_col_1700" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#334155;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacing=6;" value="<b>3. Event-Driven Inference (Part E / A17 / D10):</b><br/>• Confirmation, Verification, Estimation call Amazon Bedrock.<br/>• Model: Nova Pro in us-east-1 on-demand, zero-shot (ASM-160).<br/>• Trigger: DynamoDB Stream pipe to EventBridge (ASM-149).<br/>• Bedrock output: Confidence in [0, 1] + pest_signs.<br/>• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems appends result.<br/>• Failure safety: If call fails, state stays unchanged (Part E)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="800" x="1700" y="2155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pnl_col_2520" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#334155;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacing=6;" value="<b>4. Case, Order & S3 Traceability (ASM-145, ASM-146):</b><br/>• Storage: DynamoDB records table under KMS key 'records'.<br/>• Retention: 5-year compliance lifecycle for all records & S3 objects.<br/>• Flight Record: Mandatory flight closure ('completed' / 'aborted').<br/>• Observability: A21 monitors unclosed fumigations, unflown orders,<br/> and missions in dispatched/flown without persisted records.<br/>• S3 Block Public Access; opaque identifiers only (no PII, ASM-145)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="800" x="2520" y="2155" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
CASE INVARIANTS (Section 5.1 / ADR-002):
• Alert Deduplication: Alerts on a plot with an open case join its alert_refs; no duplicate case is opened (ASM-141).
• Mode Boundary: Plot enters Precision Mode on case opening. Returns to Area Mode ONLY on terminal closure (closed or closed_without_fumigation).
• Closure Guard: If the verification object or flight path does not arrive, case stays in verifying (open) and A21 alarms report it.

div.div:
FUMIGATION ORDER INVARIANTS (Section 5.2 / ADR-002):
• Human Authorization Mandatory: 'La autorización de fumigación es una identidad humana. Ningún disparador la ejecuta.' Function roles strictly denied.
• No-Signal Store-and-Forward: An order in flown does NOT expire at window_end: the flight occurred in window and sits in local buffer (PD-141).
• Executed State Flags: Order reaches executed on ANY persisted fumigation flight record. Flagged (not blocked) if: aborted_closure, out_of_window, batch_mismatch, or late_record (ASM-146).
• Order Closure: Moves to closed on ANY persisted verification result (both can_close and cannot_close close the order, ASM-141).

div.div:
MISSION INVARIANTS (Section 5.3 / A15 / A17):
• Five Mandatory Services: 'Los cinco entran. No se sustituye uno por otro.' Types: delimitation, confirmation, fumigation, verification, estimation.
• Upload Quarantine: Objects failing grant/checksum checks go to quarantine/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/ and do NOT count toward persistence (PD-104).
• Inference Decoupling: Drone inference functions trigger on mission_record_persisted via DynamoDB Streams -> EventBridge, NEVER on raw S3 object arrival (ASM-149).
• Flight Without Persisted Record: A mission in dispatched or flown without a persisted record is flagged as unpersisted flight (Point 6 / A21).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 3283px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2111px; margin-left: 91px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #ffffff;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#ffffff, #121212); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: CROSS-CUTTING GOVERNANCE, ACTOR ROLES & LIFECYCLE INVARIANTS (docs/drone-service.md, ADR-002, A09, A15, A17)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2151px; margin-left: 90px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
1. Agronomist Role (SR2/JR2 | Cognito staff MFA):
• Only authorized identity for fumigation orders.
• Must have fresh MFA session (auth_time <= 10 min, ASM-092).
• Authorizer ID captured from token; cannot be operator.
• Re-checks cases: closes without fumigation or requests new confirmation / verification.
• Sets window (window_start, window_end) and product batch.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2151px; margin-left: 910px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
2. Contracted Pilot & Drone Kit (A09 sec 6):
• Pilot in Cognito staff with MFA; Aerocivil permit verified (ASM-020).
• Drone Kit registered as AWS IoT Thing with X.509 certificate.
• Upload Grant: IoT MQTT grant limits uploads to exact S3 keys.
• Preload: Mission package downloaded before takeoff.
• Non-volatile encrypted buffer: Survives zero-signal flights.
• Buffer eviction: Strictly conditional on persistence receipt.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2151px; margin-left: 1730px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
3. Event-Driven Inference (Part E / A17 / D10):
• Confirmation, Verification, Estimation call Amazon Bedrock.
• Model: Nova Pro in us-east-1 on-demand, zero-shot (ASM-160).
• Trigger: DynamoDB Stream pipe to EventBridge (ASM-149).
• Bedrock output: Confidence in [0, 1] + pest_signs.
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems appends result.
• Failure safety: If call fails, state stays unchanged (Part E).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2151px; margin-left: 2550px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #334155;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#334155, #acb8c9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
4. Case, Order & S3 Traceability (ASM-145, ASM-146):
• Storage: DynamoDB records table under KMS key 'records'.
• Retention: 5-year compliance lifecycle for all records & S3 objects.
• Flight Record: Mandatory flight closure ('completed' / 'aborted').
• Observability: A21 monitors unclosed fumigations, unflown orders,
and missions in dispatched/flown without persisted records.
• S3 Block Public Access; opaque identifiers only (no PII, ASM-145).
